resource_bounds: Byte admission occurs before prewalk. Reader fetch uses io.LimitReader MaxBytes+1 with sourceProgressReader; optional WriterTo cannot bypass checks.

Bounded repeated scans: each ancestor scans its raw span once; depth <=32 means O(MaxBytes * MaxMIMEDepth), plus <=1024 initial 4096-byte fills. Header allocations bounded by raw bytes; warnings discarded and replayed only by final enmime.
